sharedRules.name: Daughters of the Abyss
sharedRules.description:
All friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units have the Feel No Pain 3+ ability against Psychic Attacks.
All friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units gain the Psychic Null ability:
  -> While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against Psychic Attacks.
Your army can include ANATHEMA PSYKANA units.
You cannot select Anathema Psykana as your Army Faction.
All friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units cannot be your Warlord.

sharedRules.name: Martial Ka'tah
sharedRules.description:
-> At the start of your Command phase: all friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with the Martial Katah ability are readied.
-> You can: while the unit is readied, select one: Conversai (until the end of the turn: the unit is no longer readied; during the Command phase, in your turn, the unit is eligible to start an Action even if it is within Engagement Range of enemy units or it is Battle-shocked; the unit is eligible to shoot even if it is performing an Action) / Calistus (when the unit is selected to move, until the end of the phase: the unit is no longer readied; during the Movement phase, in your turn, the unit can move over models as though they were not there, during its Normal, Advance and Fall Back moves) / Salvus (when the unit is selected to shoot, until the end of the phase: the unit is no longer readied; during the Shooting phase, in your turn, the unit ignores any modifiers to its Ballistic Skill characteristics; the unit ignores any modifiers to its Hit and Wound rolls) / Dacatarai (at the start of the Fight phase, until the end of the phase: the unit is no longer readied; while making melee attacks, while the target is an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER or VEHICLE units), you can re-roll a Hit roll of 1 with melee weapons) / Kaptaris (at the start of the Fight phase, until the end of the phase: the unit is no longer readied; against melee attacks, the attacking unit gets -1 to Hit rolls) / Rendax (when the unit is selected to fight, until the end of the phase: the unit is no longer readied; during the Fight phase, against MONSTER or VEHICLE targets, melee weapons equipped by models in this unit gain [LETHAL HITS]).

sharedRules.name: Special Move Types
sharedRules.description:
Shock Disembark Move (the Shock mode of a Disembark move):
  - Each model is set up wholly within 3" of that Transport.
  - A unit can make this move only if the unit is embarked and the Transport this unit is embarked within is on the battlefield and the unit did not embark this phase.
  - After it moves, until the end of the turn: the unit cannot declare a charge.

rules.name: Assemblage of Might
rules.description:
You can: During the Command phase, in your turn, until the start of your next Command phase:
  -> Select one enemy unit:

rules.name: Silent Sisterhood
rules.description:
All friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA CHARACTER models can be your Warlord.
All friendly PROSECUTOR SQUAD units gain the BATTLELINE keyword.
All friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units gain the Creeping Dread (Aura) ability:
  -> At the start of the Battle Shock step in your opponent's turn: while an enemy unit is within 12" of this unit, if the unit has the PSYKER keyword or while the unit is below its starting strength, that unit must take a Battle-shock test, applying -1 to that test.

rules.name: Moritoi Ancients
rules.description:
Unless a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is below its starting strength, add 2 to that unit's Objective Control characteristic.
While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is below its starting strength, you can re-roll a Hit roll of 1 for attacks made by that unit.
While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is below half strength:
  -> You can re-roll a Hit roll of 1 for attacks made by that unit.
  -> You can re-roll a Wound roll of 1 for attacks made by that unit.

rules.name: Gilded Guardians
rules.description:
While the target is within range of an objective marker, against ranged attacks, while the target is a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding MONSTER or VEHICLE units), when the attack's S is more than the target's T, the attacking unit gets -1 to Wound rolls.
While the Salvus option of Martial Katah is active, add 6 to the Range characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit.

rules.name: Instruments of the Emperor's Wrath
rules.description:
You can re-roll the Charge roll for all friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units.
While the Dacatarai option of Martial Katah is active, while an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of the unit, subtract 2" from that unit's Pile-in and Consolidation moves.

rules.name: Heralds of the Throne
rules.description:
All friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units gain the Fights First ability.
While the Conversai option of Martial Katah is active:
  -> Until the end of the turn: the unit is eligible to start an Action even if it Advanced this turn or it Fell Back this turn.

rules.name: Magna Imperator
rules.description:
-> When a friendly unit is selected to shoot or fight (the triggering unit must have ADEPTUS CUSTODES):
  -> You can re-roll one Hit roll.
  -> You can re-roll one Wound roll.
-> You can: while the Rendax option of Martial Katah is active, select one enemy unit with the MONSTER or VEHICLE keyword if the selected unit is within Engagement Range of the unit: roll one D6: on 1-2, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on 3-5, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on 6, that unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Flare Shields
rules.description: Against ranged attacks, all friendly GRAV-ASSAULT units have a 4+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Martial Mastery

  Select one of the following:
    - Melee weapons equipped by the triggering unit gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
    - Melee weapons equipped by the triggering unit gain [LETHAL HITS].

rules.name: Wardens of the Dark Cells
rules.description:
While the target is within range of an objective marker, against melee attacks, while the target is a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding MONSTER or VEHICLE units), when the attack's S is more than the target's T, the attacking unit gets -1 to Wound rolls.
While the Kaptaris option of Martial Katah is active:
  -> Select one enemy unit if the selected unit is within Engagement Range of the unit (each unit can be selected for this ability at most once per phase across your army): that unit must take a Battle-shock test, applying -1 to that test.

rules.name: Talon Sortie
rules.description:
-> Each time a friendly unit Falls Back (the triggering unit must have ADEPTUS CUSTODES): the triggering unit is eligible to declare a charge even if it Fell Back this turn.
While the Calistus option of Martial Katah is active, add 2 to the unit's Move characteristic.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: During the first battle round, during the Movement phase, in your turn, the unit can make an Ingress move.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
You can: Once per phase per army:
  -> The unit is eligible to be targeted with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem even if it has already been targeted with that Stratagem this phase.
  -> Reduce the CP cost of that use of the Stratagem by 1CP (to a minimum of 0CP).
  -> The unit's Rapid Ingress ability has no limit on its number of uses, and this use does not count toward that ability's limit for other units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
This model gains the Stealth ability.
This model gains the Lone Operative ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
At the start of each phase, you may use this ability, once per battle round per army:
  -> Select one friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit within 9" of this model that is Battle-shocked: that unit is no longer Battle-shocked.
Applies to: units with ADEPTUS CUSTODES.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
At the end of each phase, if this model was destroyed this phase (1+ times), once per battle per army:
  -> Roll one D6: on a 2+, this model must be set up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed more than 1" away from all enemy models, with 3 wounds remaining.
Applies to: units with ADEPTUS CUSTODES, INFANTRY.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
While the target is not an enemy unit that is a PSYKER unit or a unit that is Battle-shocked, the unit gets +1 to Hit rolls.
While the target is an enemy unit that is a PSYKER unit or a unit that is Battle-shocked, the unit gets +1 to Hit rolls.
While the target is an enemy unit that is a PSYKER unit or a unit that is Battle-shocked, the unit gets +1 to Wound rolls.
Applies to: units with ANATHEMA PSYKANA.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
You can: During the Movement phase, in your turn:
  -> Select one enemy unit visible to this model if the selected unit is within 12" of the unit: that unit must take a Battle-shock test, applying -1 to that test.
Applies to: units with ANATHEMA PSYKANA.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.
Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.
Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At the start of each phase, once per battle per army, this model regains up to D3+3 lost wounds.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Improve the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Melee weapons equipped by this model gain [CLEAVE 1].

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Melee weapons equipped by this model gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model gains 1 Auriferous Orb Emissaries Imperatus weapon.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
If the unit charged this turn:
  -> You can re-roll a Hit roll of 1 for attacks made by this model.
  -> You can re-roll a Wound roll of 1 for attacks made by this model.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
The attacking unit gets -1 to Hit rolls.
Applies to: units with ADEPTUS CUSTODES.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Melee weapons equipped by this model gain [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].
Applies to: units with SHIELD-CAPTAIN.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
When a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit embarked within the unit is selected to make a Disembark move, until the end of the turn:
  -> You can re-roll the Charge roll for the triggering unit.
  -> Your opponent cannot target the triggering unit with Overwatch.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When the unit ends a Fall Back move, the unit is eligible to shoot even if it Fell Back this turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While the target is an enemy unit with the CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE keyword, this model gets +1 to Wound rolls.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model gains 1 Emperors Light Guardians of the Throne weapon.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
After deployment, you may use this ability:
  -> Select up to 3 friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units:
    -> For each selected unit:
      Select one of the following:
        - That unit can be set up on the battlefield.
        - That unit can be placed into Strategic Reserves, ignoring any limits on units in Strategic Reserves.
Applies to: units with SHIELD-CAPTAIN.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Add 1 to this model's Wounds characteristic.
-> When damage is allocated to this model, you may use this ability, once per battle per army: this model has a 3+ invulnerable save.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When an enemy unit is selected to make an ingress move, the triggering unit cannot be set up on the battlefield within 12" of the unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
You can: Once per phase per unit:
  -> The unit is eligible to be targeted with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem even if it has already been targeted with that Stratagem this phase.
  -> Reduce the CP cost of that use of the Stratagem by 1CP (to a minimum of 0CP).
  -> The unit's Heroic Intervention ability has no limit on its number of uses, and this use does not count toward that ability's limit for other units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
When the unit is selected to make a Pile-in or Consolidation move, you may use this ability:
  -> The unit can move up to 4", during its Pile-in and Consolidation moves.
  -> The unit can select any Consolidation mode for its Consolidation moves, ignoring that Consolidation move's Before Moving restrictions.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
At the start of your Charge phase, until the end of the phase:
  -> Select one friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit within 6" of this model: that unit is eligible to declare a charge even if it Advanced this turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
The unit gets +1 to Advance rolls.
The unit gets +1 to Charge rolls.
